Builds cleanly into a real Windows PE binary. Setup is complete:

- **`cargo init`** created the package (`winhook-tool`).
- **`Cargo.toml`** — `winapi = "0.3.9"` added under `[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]` (features: `winuser`, `processthreadsapi`, `handleapi`), so it only links on Windows and won't even attempt to fetch on other platforms.
- **`src/main.rs`** — a `#[cfg(not(windows))] compile_error!` guard makes the Windows-only constraint explicit at compile time, plus a small demo (`GetCurrentProcessId`, `OpenProcess`/`CloseHandle`, `MessageBoxW`) proving the raw Win32 bindings link and work.
- **`.cargo/config.toml`** sets the default build target to `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` (already installed via rustup on this machine), so plain `cargo build`/`cargo check` produce a real Windows PE binary even when developing from Linux — confirmed with `file` above.
